g.text: Many questions favor JEV and Luna
JEV and Luna become much cheaper per answer when questions share evidence
1 packet = shared evidence + all questions. The right panel divides packet cost by question count.
Clef ends at 50 questions. Mercury omitted from cost curves: promotional free pricing.
At 100 questions, per 1,000 answers: JEV $0.0047, Luna $0.0156. Question counts evenly spaced.
